+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8680'
+title: 'MTP: compiled 2-token verify path for Qwen35 with the fused GDN kernel'
+---
+## What
+A verify pass has `x.dim(1) == 2` and sets `mtpCacheCheckpointIndexKey`. The guards in `Qwen35DecoderLayer.callAsFunction` (Libraries/MLXLLM/Models/Qwen35.swift ~797) and `Qwen35TextModelInner.forward` (~988) send it to the general path. That path has no compiled segments and no fused GDN kernel, and `recurrentBody` runs `gatedDeltaUpdate` two times to take the checkpoint. Measured: the 2-row matmuls cost only 1.10× a 1-row step (scratchpad rows.py), but a full MTP round costs 1.31× a plain step.
+
+- [ ] Extend `GatedDeltaDecodeKernel` (Libraries/MLXLMCommon/GatedDeltaDecodeKernel.swift) to T ≤ 4 tokens: loop over the tokens in the threadgroup, roll the conv window, and write the recurrent state and conv state after token `checkpointAfter` as extra outputs (the rollback checkpoint). Keep the T = 1 output bit-identical to the current kernel.
+- [ ] Add a fixed-shape S = 2 decode schedule to `Qwen35TextModelInner` (reuse `CompiledDecodeSegment` / `CompiledDecodeSegmentCache`, keyed by S) that returns the checkpoint states and feeds `MambaCache.saveSpeculativeCheckpoint`.
+- [ ] Emit the drafter hidden rows (`applyFinalNorm: false` path, Qwen35TextModel.forward ~1191) from the compiled path.
+- [ ] Use `DecodeAttentionKernel` / `PrefillAttentionKernel` for the 2-query attention step where they apply.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] The verify output (logits, hidden rows, caches, and checkpoint) of the compiled path is within the existing `AttentionKernelTolerance`, and bit-identical where the existing GDN bitwise tests require it, against the general path.
+- [ ] `qwen38FourBitMTPGeneration`: MTP tok/s on the math category improves by ≥ 8% against the baseline of 52.3 tok/s, and the output still matches plain decode.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] Tests/MLXLMTests/Qwen35GDNDecodeKernelTests.swift: T = 2..4 kernel against the op path, including the checkpoint outputs.
+- [ ] Tests/MLXLMTests/Qwen35MTPTests.swift: compiled S = 2 verify against the general path, for rounds that accept and rounds that reject.
+- [ ] `swift build --build-tests && xcrun xctest .build/out/Products/Debug/MLXLMTests.xctest` passes; then run the Release benchmark.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass. #mtp #qwen38 #perf
\ No newline at end of file

The conv state of each slot is a view of the conv input window (src/models/delta-net-base.cpp, `[TAG_RECURRENT_ROLLBACK_SPLITS]`). A rollback of r tokens only selects slot r (`rs_idx` in src/llama-memory-recurrent.cpp). It does not copy and does not compute again.
